entries.zh: 寬容，寬恕；放寬（給人餘地）
entries.en: to be lenient, to give leeway; to relax (a constraint)
entries.notes: L「nado／alboçoria」詞形難解，釋義據 H 寬 及兩欄對音而立。

entries.zh: 可以寬恕，可原諒；可放寬（對人讓步）
entries.en: to be forgivable, excusable; to give others leeway

entries.zh: 改為寬容，放鬆；放寬（改鬆尺度）
entries.en: to relent, to become lenient; to loosen
to confer, to deliberate together
entries.notes: H 殘損存疑（托／抳），M 四音節與 H 不合；據 L conferencia 定為會商。

entries.zh: 交付，交給；托付（以手承托而與人）
entries.en: to hand over, to deliver; to entrust (a thing)
entries.notes: L 末「entre sta」不明，據 H 托 釋為交付托付。

entries.en: to give one's word, to promise
to conclude a covenant, to pledge one's word
entries.notes: 斷取「決斷立約」義，非「斷絕」，與 L dar la palabra 相合。

entries.en: to strike, to hit; to wound
to congratulate, to wish joy (dar el parabién)
to offer congratulations, to rejoice with someone

entries.zh: 以書面陳報；遞呈詞（書面陳述）
entries.en: to give a written account; to submit a written statement
to kick, to give a kick
entries.notes: L 疑為 dar puntapié（踢）；H「蹕／踺」殘損，與 M、R 不合。

entries.en: to lay a scheme, to set a trap; to contrive
entries.notes: L「traca」疑為 traza（謀劃）；M 四音節與 H 局 對應不明。

entries.en: to give betrothal gifts; to pay the bride-price
to give the betrothal token; to settle a marriage by pledge

entries.zh: 讓先，讓人佔先；退讓（遜讓）
entries.en: to give someone the advantage, a head start; to yield
money; money for expenses
entries.notes: L 後半「aelgſena」殘損難解，未據以釋義。

entries.en: a means of earning money, income; livelihood
entries.notes: 同前條，L 殘損；H／M／R 明指「錢路」。

entries.zh: 相競，爭勝；彼此推擠較量
entries.en: to vie and jostle with one another, to contend
entries.notes: L「controloes」疑為 encontrones（相撞推擠）之訛。

entries.en: to bestow, to grant (a superior to an inferior)
entries.notes: L「el inferior」疑為「al inferior」（給下屬），與 賜 之上給下相合。

entries.en: to give sustenance; to provide for, to maintain
entries.notes: H 廩／靈 形近難辨；L「sustento, o sustentar」義明。

entries.en: to turn round, to spin (as wheels do)
entries.notes: L 末字殘（疑 ruedas 車輪）；H 輦／輩 形近，輦即車。

entries.en: 〔original damaged, gloss uncertain〕
